main_text.l: Aut vitas, lege aut vitia. probant sequentia.
Visu granidis. Prior vox mendum continet. Scrib.
Soleatus pro lectulo. Fortean, vt è lectulo. κρηπῖδας
ἔ-χων ὡς ἀπὸ τῆς κλινῆς. Sed videtur qui Lyconis locū
è Graeco vertit, reperisse in suo codice, ἐπὶ pro ἀπὸ:
Palliolo frigus a capite defendens. Rectè palliolo sic
alibi: quia tamē Græcè scripserat Lyco, fortasse pileolo scribendum. πιλίδιον ἐν τῇ κεφαλῇ ἔχων πρὸς τὸ ψῦχος.
Iurgio proximum lacessit. τὸν πλησίον ἐρεθίζει.

page.notes: The text is set in italic and runs without indents, so it is one paragraph continuing from the previous page. The Greek in the notes is hard to read on the scan: the note on "Visu granidis" (οἰνοζαρέστ) and the note on "Soleatus" (κρηπῖδας ἔ-χων) are the least certain, and the accents may differ from the printer's. The long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. The hyphen in "para-tam" and "supe-rarit" is the printed line-end hyphen. The running head and catchword are not printed on this page.
